segments.an5.203:1.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro [bhaddo (pī.)] assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.an5.203:2.3: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.an5.203:2.4: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
segments.an5.203:3.3: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti.

lines: Tatiye adhivāsanaṃ khamanaṃ, paresaṃ dukkaṭaṃ duruttañca paṭivirodhākaraṇena attano upari āropetvā vāsanaṃ adhivāsanaṃ, tadeva khantīti adhivāsanakkhanti.
Subhe ratoti sūrato, suṭṭhu vā pāpato orato virato sorato, tassa bhāvo soraccaṃ.
Sā hi sobhanakammaratatā, suṭṭhu vā pāpato oratabhāvo viratatā.
